input.text: In this section “the retained categories” has the meaning given in Part 6 of the Data Protection Act 2018; and section 98(7) of that Act applies for this purpose.
input.preceding_text: This Part amends the Consumer Credit Act 1974 in consequence.

references.literal: Part 6 of the Data Protection Act 2018

_note: A host-qualified pinpoint (‘section 98(7) of that Act’) stays INTERNAL regardless of a DIFFERENT Act named in an earlier sentence. Constructed wording.
